pages.text: $(l)Mekanism's ladder$()$(br)The $(item)Metallurgic Infuser$() (it takes an HV Capacitor), infused alloy, then ore processing: two, three, four and five ingots from each ore. Gases move through pressurized tubes.
Fission: a casing shell, fuel assemblies, control rods and ports. Start at a low burn rate and keep it cooled.
Set a $(item)Reactor Logic Adapter$() to shut the reactor down when it overheats. Cheap insurance against a meltdown.

$(l)The gate$()$(br)Four $(item)Plutonium Pellets$(): fission waste spun in an isotopic centrifuge and pressed in a reaction chamber.$(br2)Also open: $(thing)World Tiers$() (Ctrl+T), $(thing)Compact Machines$() and the $(thing)Otherside$().
